purpose: Document first-party registry/map discovery, viewer/service evidence, bounded anonymous request outcomes, and safety limits.
assessment: Boa Vista's official municipal pages evidence a local Department of Real Estate Cadastre and cadastral administrative services. The current public cartographic page exposes two downloadable base-cartography PDFs, not a parcel feature service. No safe anonymous parcel ID-plus-complete-geometry response was obtained; no sample GeoJSON was retained.
registryAssessment: The Departamento de Cadastro Imobiliário (DCI) is identified on the official municipal secretariat page and is the local cadastral custodian evidenced here. The citizen portal documents cadastro imobiliário, lot registration, and a certificate with limits and measurements. General federal or state material was not treated as local custody.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official municipal page identifies the Departamento de Cadastro Imobiliário (DCI), its secretariat, municipal address and contact details.
Official municipal Mapa Cartográfico page exposes Base Cartográfica Municipal 2016 and 2020 as PDF downloads.
Official citizen portal documents the certificate-with-limits-and-measurements workflow and requires applicant/property documentation; no public parcel geometry endpoint is exposed.
Official citizen portal documents lot registration as an administrative service and lists required identity and property-chain documents; no public parcel geometry endpoint is exposed.
Official municipal page links to Matricula Online, but the linked public application identifies itself as an education-enrollment product and was excluded from cadastral qualification.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Official Boa Vista DCI custody, citizen-service workflows, municipal map page and linked public application shell.

remainingUncertainty: Native parcel identity, schema, CRS, API access policy, and coverage remain unverified. Administrative certificate/registration workflows and PDF cartography do not establish an open parcel geometry service. Failed or unrelated routes are not evidence of citywide absence.
